votes.refutation: I first tested the upstream-guarantee argument: the webhook re-review path checks bot authors at tasks.py:169-172, and signal task execution ordinarily uses bot credentials. Those facts do not validate the initial receiver's mutable output.pr_url. The set_output API can change the selected PR without changing the task's signal-report identity, and the separate initial task does not invoke the webhook's bot guard. Other gates still review the diff, so this does not guarantee approval of malicious code; it does prove that a human draft which should fail eligibility can pass that prerequisite. The existing caller facts therefore fail to refute the finding.

The Action defaults self_driving off, genuine signal executions force BOT credentials at products/tasks/backend/temporal/process_task/utils.py:1067-1074, and webhook re-reviews check bot identity at stamphog/backend/tasks/tasks.py:169-172.
